adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real inconsistency. Looking at the diff, parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts defines minimumTokenResponseSchema requiring only access_token and a number (expiry). However, in webex/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts, the code still uses webexRefreshedTokenSchema.safeParse(responseBody) at line 88 (not shown in diff but referenced). The diff shows refreshOAuthTokens is added to wrap the fetch call (lines 62-82), but the parsing logic after that still uses the original webexRefreshedTokenSchema which requires additional fields like scope, token_type, refresh_token, refresh_token_expires_in. Unlike other integrations (zoom, office365, google) that were updated to use parseRefreshTokenResponse, webex was not updated, creating an inconsistency where synced credentials following the minimal contract would fail validation.
